headlines.description: Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner urged Nvidia’s board on Monday to reconsider Jensen Huang’s ouster, saying the board needs “to get this right.” Gerstner said at Semafor’s Silicon Valley & The World that he wasn’t calling for Huang’s immediate reinstatement as Nvidia CEO but that “everyone is rushing to judgment…and I simply don’t know the facts.”
